FriendUtils.luau.description: Utility helpers for Roblox friend lists and friend presence. Public entry points include `FriendUtils.promiseFriendPages`, `FriendUtils.iterateFriendsYielding`, `FriendUtils.promiseAllFriends`, `FriendUtils.promiseOnlineFriends`, `FriendUtils.onlineFriends`, `FriendUtils.friendsWhoPlayed`, `FriendUtils.friendsInPlace`, `FriendUtils.friendsInCurrentPlace`.

PlayerUtils.luau.description: Clears all tools from a player's backpack. Public entry points include `PlayerUtils.clearTools`, `PlayerUtils.safePlayerAdded`, `PlayerUtils.fzyFindPlayerFromText`, `PlayerUtils.formatNameWithDisplay`, `PlayerUtils.formatName`, `PlayerUtils.formatDisplayName`, `PlayerUtils.formatDisplayNameFromUserInfo`, `PlayerUtils.addVerifiedBadgeToName`.

RxFriendUtils.luau.description: Utilities for observing the local player's friends. Public entry points include `RxFriendUtils.observeFriendsInServerAsBrios`, `handleFriendState`, `handleNewPlayerAsync`.

RxPlayerUtils.luau.description: Utilities for observing players Public entry points include `RxPlayerUtils.observePlayersBrio`, `handlePlayer`, `RxPlayerUtils.observeCharactersBrio`, `RxPlayerUtils.observeHumanoidsBrio`, `RxPlayerUtils.observePlayers`, `RxPlayerUtils.observeBackpackToolsAdded`, `handleTool`, `RxPlayerUtils.observeBackpackToolsRemoved`.
